source: Bybit V5 public market API + public WebSocket / linear perpetual

notes.daily_buckets: Native UTC 1D candles from Bybit REST.
notes.trade_flow: PublicTrade Buy turnover minus Sell turnover.
notes.cvd: Cumulative from start of available range, not absolute exchange CVD.
notes.liquidations: Bybit allLiquidation; S=Buy long liquidation; S=Sell short liquidation.
notes.flow_history: WebSocket-only; gaps cannot be backfilled here.
